challenges.instruction: Write a short Somali daily-life note.
promptLines: Write 4 short Somali sentences about your day.
Use one time word, one food or drink word, one place or direction, and one polite phrase.
challenges.placeholder: Example flow: today, food or drink, where you are going, polite ending.

requirements.label: Time word
requirements.explanation: Use one time word from Time and Days.

requirements.label: Food or drink
requirements.explanation: Use one food or drink word.

requirements.label: Polite phrase
requirements.explanation: Use one polite phrase from Common Phrases.

gradingNotes: Reward short daily-life sentences that reuse module vocabulary.
Accept beginner grammar if the required targets are present.
Be lenient with punctuation, capitalization, and minor spelling variation.
challenges.sampleAnswer: Maanta waa isniin. Koob shaah ah baan rabaa. Suuqa baan tagayaa. Mahadsanid.
